title: Mubit Launches Platform to Train Proprietary AI Models From Agent Tasks
summary:
Mubit has released a platform that allows businesses to build and own smaller, proprietary AI models based on the repetitive work performed by their AI agents. The system acts as a proxy for APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini, and can also ingest activity logs from Pydantic Logfire, Langfuse, or Braintrust. Mubit identifies repeated tasks and trains specific models for them that refresh every few minutes, allowing the customer-owned model to take over once its performance matches that of the frontier model.

The company also launched Banyan Sapling, a research preview open model available under the Apache 2.0 license that evaluates whether context supports, violates, or contradicts a claim. In company tests, the model correctly answered 779 of 1,731 cases and responded as "unsure" for the remaining instances. The launch includes a new benchmark for agentic AI evaluations.
